title: Thermodynamics of Concentrated Electrolyte Mixtures. II. Densities and Compressibilities of Aqueous NaCl-CaCl2 at 25 C
authors: Anil Kumar, Gordon Atkinson, Robert D. Howell
needs_pass2_reason: text layer needed corrections after the image check (decimal commas read as full stops, a dropped decimal point, and glyph misreads); pass-1 rule counts any correction
experimental_method: Densities by Sodev 02D vibrating-tube densimeter with a dilution flow technique and relative sound velocities by a Nusonics 6100 sing-around velocimeter, both at 25 C in a bath controlled to 0.001 C; solutions made by weight from dried NaCl and purified CaCl2.2H2O stock analysed by EDTA and AgNO3 titration.
uncertainties_stated: Density agrees with Desnoyers to +-8 ppm; uncertainty in relative density about 3 ppm; relative sound velocities precise to 6 ppm; bath +-0.001 C. Sigma of the Pitzer fit given per block.
quality_remarks: Compressibility columns are adiabatic apparent molar compressibilities calculated by the authors (not extracted). CaCl2 data described by the authors as less extensive and of lower precision than the NaCl data. Temperature scale and pressure not stated. Printed sound-velocity values at I=0.5,y=0.8504 and I=1,y=0.9510 look out of sequence; kept as printed. The PDF text layer is OCR with many glyph errors.
